multiplechoiceresponse.p: A required field is blank and the workflow sends the draft anyway. What is missing?

choice.div: Input validation that stops the workflow before generation.

div.p: The input contract must be enforced. Without it, the workflow produces plausible output from missing data.

multiplechoiceresponse.p: Which review is specific enough to rely on?

choice.div: "The agent checks the balance in the billing system and the refund policy before sending."
"The team keeps an eye on it."

div.p: A check needs a person, a source, and a criterion. Otherwise it is a hope.

multiplechoiceresponse.p: The AI service is unavailable for a morning. What should the runbook contain?

choice.div: A tested fallback to the manual process.
An instruction to wait until it returns.
A note that this cannot happen.

div.p: A workflow without a fallback becomes a work stoppage. The fallback must be written and practiced.

choiceresponse.p: Which are required parts of an assisted workflow? Select all that apply.

choice.div: A promise that the model will always be right.

div.p: Input, output, check and escalation are the controls. Accuracy is not guaranteed by any of them, which is why the check exists.
